definition: Optical braille recognition is technology to capture and process images of braille characters into natural language characters.
details: It is used to convert braille documents for people who cannot read them into text, and for preservation and reproduction of the documents.
story: Picture a child pointing at pictures in a book — cat, car, cloud — learning to see by seeing a thousand examples. Think of it this way: Optical braille recognition is technology to capture and process images of braille characters into natural language characters. And here is the clever part: It is used to convert braille documents for people who cannot read them into text, and for preservation and reproduction of the documents. It is eyes made of arithmetic — pixels become edges, edges become shapes, shapes become meaning. And that is Optical braille recognition — giving a machine the gift of sight.
